responsibility: Implements the sanitizer optimization-and-expansion pass that runs after sanitizer instrumentation has been inserted, deduplicating and simplifying sanitizer checks across the CFG and then lowering internal sanitizer calls such as IFN_ASAN_CHECK, IFN_HWASAN_CHECK, IFN_ASAN_MARK/POISON, and IFN_UBSAN_* into concrete GIMPLE control flow and runtime calls. It also performs sanitizer-specific housekeeping such as rewriting addressable parameters for stack sanitization, tracking ASan/HWASan access counts to choose call-based instrumentation thresholds, and committing edge insertions created during poison/unpoison expansion.
